title: Damping of phonons in Bose gas at low temperatures
summary: We consider a homogeneous Bose gas in a large cubic box with periodic boundary conditions interacting with a small potential with a positive Fourier transform. We compute the imaginary part of the phononic excitation spectrum in the lowest order of perturbation theory in the thermodynamic limit at low temperatures and low momentum. Our analysis is based on perturbation theory of the standard Liouvillean.
